values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

values.note: DEC says 287 campsites, tents to 40-ft RVs; ReserveAmerica lists 268 campsites and a group camp, equipment lengths 20-40 ft (45 at 40 ft), all back-in except one 20-ft pull-through (site 37). On-water sites are on the pond side of the campground road. Some sites close for DEC's Campsite Restoration Project.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident (DEC page), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added same-day until 5 pm, no walk-ins (fcfs never), no electric (catalog), 287 sites to 40 ft with one 20-ft pull-through, showers/flush toilets/dump. Season left as set today from RA's 2027 schedule (May 14-Sep 11); DEC's page gives May 15-Sep 13 (2026). Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
